Курс

The intended direction of flight expressed as an angle from North, along which an aircraft is to be flown.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Курс?

In this glossary, Курс refers to: The intended direction of flight expressed as an angle from North, along which an aircraft is to be flown.

How is Курс used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Сохраняйте текущий курс до указания, затем поверните влево на курс 090."

Why does Курс matter in aviation?

Курс matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Курс?

Курс is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Курс belong to?

In this glossary, Курс is grouped under Navigation. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition
